summary: CLAIM C-0004: What is genuinely unknown: the exact lifting mechanism, the leveling of the base, and how the final top blocks were placed.
content: Genuinely unknown aspects: (1) the exact lifting mechanism for the blocks, especially the heaviest granite beams up to 60-80 tons (EV-0004, EV-0006); (2) how the astonishingly level base was excavated and leveled from bedrock (EV-0005, per Lehner 'nobody ever built a platform like that before'); (3) how the final blocks at the top were placed (EV-0005). These are the load-bearing unknowns, distinct from the well-established transport story.
